verses.1: To David, I sing your praises with all my heart, in the face of God.
verses.2: I will bow down before your holy temple, and I will praise your name for your kindness and truth. For you have exalted your name above all others.
verses.3: On that day, I cried out to God, and He answered me with a terrible response. My heart was filled with sorrow.
verses.4: May the LORD be praised, O all the kings of the earth! For they have heard Your words.
verses.5: And they will serve in the ways of Jehovah, for Jehovah’s glory is great.
verses.6: For Jehovah is exalted and humble at the same time; He is far away, yet His power is known.
verses.7: If I am in distress, may your right hand save me from my enemies. May your hand rescue me from all my troubles.
verses.8: May the LORD finish what He has begun. May Your kindness last forever, O Lord. May Your works be done forever.
